This product does not work at all.  I used it religiously and saw no difference at all.  The "real" product is called "Lashboost" by Rodan and Fields.  I am using that now and have noticed a remarkable change in the length in just over a month.  I wish I had known the truth before.
Not as effective as the reviews say and very expensive. Don't buy this product isn't worth the price.

reviews.t: I have only been using this product for a couple ...
reviews.x: I have only been using this product for a couple of weeks. It usually takes 6 - 8 weeks to see the improvement but I find it to be working already.

I was a bit sceptical in the beginning, cause similar products usually are priced way more than this. After I was referred by a friend, I ordered this boostlash and it was shipped the same day and I received it shortly. I have used it for about 10 days and it has already done it's magic. I can honestly say it is working better than the much more expensive product that I used before. I have felt no discomfort and I'm ready to place another order. Great product ! Great seller !

I have used this product daily since I purchased it 2 months ago.  I kept hoping for a change in my eyelashes, like the reviews I read..... However NO change at all.  This product is nothing more than water, or at least same out come.  I wish it was everything they said, but it's not.  Don't waste your money.  I've used other products in the past with very noticeable thick and longer eyelashes ( like rapid lash).

reviews.t: I've used this regularly for five months at the time ...
reviews.x: I've used this regularly for five months at the time of this review.  There is no noticeable difference in the color and thickness of my lashes.  I have not noticed more lashes either.  The lashes I do have appear to be longer and don't shed as quickly, so there's that.  I had higher expectations. I do have some lightening of the skin at the base of my lashes where the product is applied.

After using this BoostLash for more than two months, I have seen little to no improvement in lash thickness/fullness. Lash length may be marginally longer but only noticeable when wearing mascara. For the price, I would not buy this product again. I would be willing to pay more for a product that shows stronger results.

I started using this Boostlash eyelash serum about one month ago.  It is definitely working.  My eyelashes have grown.  I used a product a few years ago that worked great and then the company changed the formulation in it and it stopped working.  Please DON'T change Boostlash!

Nothing special.  Have tried many lash lengtheners/thickeners at many price points.  Maybe all that can be done has already been achieved.  This did nothing noticeable for me, and was definitely higher price point.  I won't buy again.
Used for three weeks and no change in length or fullness of eyelashes.  Disappointed.
This does not work.  Fact of the matter my eyelashes became thinner.  Don't waste your money!!

Ever since I've switched to this product,  my lashes are much fuller, thicker, and I've noticed that they don't fall out anymore. I already have very long eyelashes, but I can see some difference in length as well.
I am loving the results. My friends at work have noticed the difference in my eye lashes. I have a lot of friends who are going to purchase boost lash because of my results. I love it!!

So far, I think Lash Boost is working. Because product says one should use this for six-ish weeks, it may be too soon to say; but I do think my lashes are getting thicker. It's definitely easy to use, and I do apply it twice daily. I had been using Latisse in the past, which made my lashes longer but not thicker. Lash Boost seems to be making my lashes actually thicker.

reviews.t: A bit disappointed. I have been using it as directed and ...
reviews.x: A bit disappointed. I have been using it as directed and don't see much growth. I will continue til the bottle is empty and give another review. Maybe it just takes me longer than most to see results. I'm checking back in;  It's been almost 2 months and my eyelashes are awesome. they are so long and I am very happy with the product.

reviews.x: Maybe as I continue to use this product, I will be able to give it a 5 star rating. At this point in time, I am getting results, which I am satisfied with. I am hoping that with continued use, the results will also improve. I would still recommend this product. I have experience no adverse side effects from using this product.

reviews.x: I have been applying twice a day since mid-August and I have not seen any difference.  The other poor reviews I thought were only because they didn't use it long enough but they were completely right.  It was a waste of my money.

I have been applying this product every night for over a month and there is no noticeable difference. Wish I didn't buy, waste of time and money and yes, as posted in another review product gets in your eye and causes discomfort.
I love my eyelash Serum.  After 2 months of using it I am beginning to have beautiful eyelashes and eyebrows.  At 55 I am thrilled!  I would recommend this to anyone.

claims.text: Many reviewers report visible lash growth or improvement, often noticing results within weeks.
Several reviewers say the product did not work for them or showed little to no noticeable difference.
Some reviewers consider the product expensive or not worth the price.
A few reviewers mention eye irritation or swelling from use.
Some reviewers compare it favorably to other lash products, including Lash Boost/Revitalash, citing effectiveness and lower cost.
